question: The Defence Ministry’s planned order for 500 Invar anti-tank guided missiles—valued at ₹2,000–3,000 crore—will be placed with which defence Public Sector Unit (PSU)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharat Dynamics Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL)** is a **government-owned defence Public Sector Unit (PSU)** headquartered in **Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.
 
• It was established in **1970** by the Government of India to manufacture guided weapon systems.
 
• BDL specializes in the production of **anti-tank guided missiles (ATGMs), surface-to-air missiles, torpedoes, and other ammunition.**
 
• The **Invar anti-tank guided missile** is a product that falls under its expertise in guided weapon systems.
 
• BDL plays a key role in India's defence sector by providing indigenous solutions to strengthen the country’s military capabilities.
 
• The planned order for **500 Invar anti-tank guided missiles** valued between ₹2,000–₹3,000 crore demonstrates India's commitment to boosting domestic defence production.
 
• The missiles are primarily used for **armoured vehicles and tanks** to enhance their ability to destroy enemy targets effectively.
 
• This order aligns with the Indian government’s **‘Make in India’ initiative**, promoting self-reliance in defence manufacturing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Armoured Vehicles Nigam Ltd. (AVNL)**__

 __
 
• **AVNL** is a government-owned corporation that specializes in manufacturing **armoured vehicles and military hardware.**
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Defence and focuses on providing solutions for **ground-based combat systems.**
 
• Its production facilities are spread across India, including **Heavy Vehicle Factory (HVF) in Avadi**, Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)**__
 __
 
• **BEL** is another defence PSU headquartered in **Bengaluru, Karnataka.**
 
• It primarily focuses on manufacturing **electronic equipment, radars, communication systems, and avionics.**
 
• BEL is not involved in the production of anti-tank guided missiles but plays a critical role in **electronic warfare and radar systems.**
 
 
 
• **Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd. (GRSE)**__
 
 
• **GRSE** is a defence PSU specializing in the construction of **warships, patrol vessels, and other marine platforms.**
 
• It is headquartered in **Kolkata, West Bengal.**
 
• GRSE's expertise lies in shipbuilding and engineering, not in missile systems.
